item.title: Unreleased D4vd Track Adds New Questions To The Celeste Rivas Investigation
item.description: Following the discovery of fourteen year old Celeste Rivas Hernandez's remains in a vehicle linked to artist D4vd, an unreleased track titled Celeste Demo Unfin surfaced online. The recording sparked immediate public interest as law enforcement officials examined its lyrics and context alongside physical evidence. Authorities continue their investigation into the surrounding timeline and circumstances to determine what happened to Celeste Rivas.

item.title: He Was Only 10 When A Predator Chose Him
item.description: Clark Fredericks was just 10 years old when he says a trusted Boy Scout leader began years of horrific sexual abuse. Decades later, unable to escape the trauma, Fredericks confronted the man he accused of destroying his childhood—leading to a case that reignited debate over abuse, justice, and the lifelong impact of predatory crimes.

item.title: Locked Away And Isolated For 13 Years
item.description: Genie Wiley spent the first 13 years of her life hidden from the world, confined in near-total isolation and subjected to unimaginable abuse by her father. Her rescue exposed one of the most heartbreaking child abuse cases in American history and forever changed the way researchers understood childhood development and language acquisition.

item.title: He Believed Murder Would Stop Earthquakes
item.description: Herbert Mullin murdered 13 people across California after becoming convinced their deaths were necessary to prevent a catastrophic earthquake. Investigators later uncovered a chilling series of seemingly random killings driven by severe delusions, making him one of America's most infamous serial killers.

item.title: The Voices Told Him To Kill His Parents
item.description: Long before Robert Maudsley became one of Britain's most infamous prisoners, he repeatedly told doctors he heard voices urging him to kill his abusive parents. Instead, his untreated trauma spiraled into a series of murders that would leave him confined alone in a specially built glass cell for decades.

item.title: A Husband And Wife Vanished Without A Trace
item.description: Patrick and Linda Duffey disappeared under mysterious circumstances, leaving investigators to piece together what happened in the days before they vanished. Conflicting evidence, unanswered questions, and a trail that suddenly went cold have kept the case shrouded in mystery for years.

item.title: She Was Found Inside A Suitcase
item.description: Eight-year-old Sandra Cantu vanished while playing near her California home, triggering a desperate search. Days later, her body was discovered inside a suitcase, leading investigators to uncover a shocking suspect and one of the most heartbreaking child murder cases in recent history.
